note: Intentional padded manufacturerName strings (P2941 byte-exact padding, P2958 dedicated drivers). Additive and sourced; separate from tools/ci/identifier-audit-baseline.json, which stays shrink-only. tools/ci/identifier-audit.js accepts ONLY the exact string in the listed driver: the same string in another driver, a case twin (e.g. lowercase) or any unlisted padded name still fails. Drivers listed here are byte-exact: case-variant bots must not add twins to them. Credit: Koenkk/zigbee-herdsman-converters (Z2M) contributors; facts restated, not copied.
